description: Render Compose @Preview functions locally and browse hosted Material 3 and Wear component catalogs.

args: PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin"; export PATH; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$1" ]; then exec node "$@"; fi; shift; exec "$@"

name: compose-preview

settings.description: Optional access token for the hosted preview.coo.ee service. Leave it blank to use the service's interactive access grant.
settings.name: Compose Preview token
